verdict.rationale: ZCode is an in-product AI coding workbench. Its docs claim built-in multimodal analysis of user-supplied content (screenshot understanding, image analysis) and multi-agent planning and verification of goals, which loosely covers AI-generated analysis of the user's own material. There is no explicit documentation of insights or suggestions derived from user data, and the only hands-on reports concern general coding quality. missing for 10: explicit documented data-insight/suggestion feature, description of what user data is analyzed and how insights are surfaced, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
